home.title: Homeopathic care from Dr. Rama Mathur
home.lead: 32 years of clinical experience. Consultations in Hindi and English, in Banipark, Jaipur.
home.cred4: years as an empanelled homoeopathic doctor at RIICO, Jaipur (1999 to 2023)
home.practiceMargin: from her own record of practice
home.practice1: Keeps detailed clinical notes and records for each patient.
home.practice2: Refers patients to other health practitioners when appropriate.
home.aboutBody: M.D. (Homoeopathy) from Rajasthan University (2001), NDDY from the Gandhi National Academy of Naturopathy (2004) and an MBA (HR) (2010). She has served as a medical officer, a guest faculty member and an empanelled homoeopathic doctor, and founded a women's welfare society in Jaipur.

book.title: Book a visit
